scripts.build:browser: node scripts/package-browser-assets.mjs && pnpm --filter @alpha-kanban/shared build && pnpm --filter @alpha-kanban/web build:browser
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @alpha-kanban/server dev" "node scripts/wait-for-url.mjs http://127.0.0.1:5174/api/health && pnpm --filter @alpha-kanban/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @alpha-kanban/shared build && pnpm --filter @alpha-kanban/server build && pnpm --filter @alpha-kanban/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @alpha-kanban/shared build && pnpm --filter @alpha-kanban/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @alpha-kanban/web typecheck
